Marcus / Marissa —

Thanks for the demo last week. Our platform team wants to move to a short evaluation window (2 weeks) once we have the environment glued together. I attached a current network inventory (novamed-network-inventory.xlsx) with VPC IDs and our primary CIDR blocks. High-level asks we want reflected in the MAP and delivery timeline: 

- Redwood creates a customer org namespace and a read/write API key limited to the evaluation project.
- Provide an IP allowlist ACL: we will provide the three egress CIDRs (see attachment).
- VPC peering from our staging VPC (aws-us-east-1) to Redwood-managed shared-services VPC; routing + security group guidance is required.
- Proof points: SOC2 summary or a pointer to where we can get evidence for procurement.

Target dates: want to begin smoke tests on Aug 12 and start controlled load on Aug 16 (two-week evaluation ending Aug 30). Can you confirm what you can deliver and ownership per MAP row?

Thanks — happy to set a 30-min sync today if required.

Best,
Alice Chen
Director, Platform Engineering
NovaMed Health

Alice —

Appreciate the clear asks and the inventory. We can meet the high-level timeline if we lock responsibilities today. Proposed immediate commitments from Redwood: 

1) Org & API key: We will provision a NovaMed evaluation org and an API key restricted to the evaluation project and set token expiry for 30 days. Expect keys to be issued within 48 business hours after privs confirmation.

2) IP allowlist: We will provide a static egress IP endpoint pool for Redwood control-plane access and a short how-to on adding your CIDRs to our allowlist. Please confirm the three CIDRs in the attached sheet.

3) VPC peering: Attached is our standard vpc-peering-template (redwood-vpc-peering-template.txt). We can do the peering from our shared-services VPC to your staging VPC in us-east-1. Network team will need your peer VPC ID and a contact for the peering acceptance step.

4) Evidence: We'll surface the SOC2 summary link and provide the standard security questionnaire answers; Marissa will follow up with the evidence pack.

I suggest a 30-min go/no-go tomorrow Aug 10 at 10:00 AM PT to confirm the MAP rows and finalize handoffs. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a concise MAP doc that maps owners and dates.

Deliverables attached: redwood-vpc-peering-template.txt, map-provisioning-checklist.pdf (draft).

–Marcus
